candidates_considered.evidence: Chess Rating Estimation from Moves and Clock Times Using a CNN-LSTM (arXiv 2409.11506; Springer 2025) is the proposal itself and reports that clock usage carries skill information board-only models cannot recover. Also RatingNet; Predicting Chess Player Rating Based on a Single Game (2023); ChessMimic (arXiv 2606.04473, 2026).
candidates_considered.name: Chess clock traces -> player rating band

candidates_considered.evidence: An established multipath and NLOS classification literature over 2021-2025 using SNR from RINEX as a primary feature; UNAVCO also publishes deterministic antenna SNR comparisons.
candidates_considered.name: GNSS SNR -> antenna / signal reception condition

candidates_considered.evidence: Automated data curation for self-supervised learning in underwater acoustic analysis (arXiv 2505.20066) pairs AIS with bulk passive-acoustic recordings to pseudo-label a large unlabelled corpus for SSL. That is the FDM-1 structure itself, already built. Also Oceanship (arXiv 2401.02099), a large-scale underwater audio target-recognition dataset.
candidates_considered.name: Hydrophone recordings + AIS -> ship class

candidates_considered.evidence: iDQ is a supervised learner over thousands of auxiliary channels that has run in real time across four observing runs, with a 2024 performance paper. Also Gravity Spy.
candidates_considered.name: LIGO strain -> detector data-quality state

candidates_considered.evidence: Adjacent to RF modulation classification, which is already on the pre-existing kill list, plus Large Scale Radio Frequency Signal Classification (arXiv 2207.09918).
candidates_considered.name: Open radio observation archives (SatNOGS) -> signal state

candidates_measured.a2_note: Best trivial baseline was linear at 0.4293; the top rung reached 0.4606.

cost.note: Cost beside quality: four rungs plus five baselines on 4 CPU cores, from a 700 MB streamed prefix of a CC0 corpus. No GPU at any point.

candidates_measured.f5_note: slope 0.03379452190383932 accuracy points per decade, ci95 [0.03059246757235225, 0.03687297607402506], r2 0.9794473704361031, permutation p 0.041666666666666664 (floor 0.041666666666666664). The curve is decelerating: the last half-decade bought 0.0032.
candidates_measured.g1_note: Lichess standard rated games, CC0. The only corpus found in the whole search where Phase 3's 'ship an open dataset' would be unambiguously legal.
candidates_measured.g2a_note: Checked by construction: the feature vector is derived from the clock trace and the advertised time control only, and contains neither player's Elo nor any move. The manufacturer (Lichess) knows a rating that aggregates thousands of games; the student sees one game's timing.
candidates_measured.g6_note: 28 float64 features per unit. 224 bytes x 1e6 = 2.24e8, far inside the 2e10 budget.
candidates_measured.name: Chess clock traces -> player rating band (PIPELINE VALIDATION, cannot be selected)
candidates_measured.status: Measured to validate the instrument end-to-end on real data, NOT to select it. It is G4-dead, which is precisely why it was chosen: a domain that cannot be selected gives no incentive to flatter the result.

governed_by: prereg/0002-phase0-round4-verdict.json (frozen before any candidate was chosen)
honest_scope: FIVE candidates were generated and white-space checked, against 99 across rounds 1-3. This round is far narrower and its negative result is correspondingly weaker evidence about the world, while being stronger evidence about what it actually measured.

fired_correctly_three_ways: tools/scaling.py REFUSED the 3-rung real dataset with exit code 3, citing the preregistered scope of >= 4 rungs. The scope gate fires on real data, not just on fixtures.

With 4 rungs spanning 2.4771 decades it produced a real fit: slope 0.03379452190383932 with a paired-bootstrap ci95 of [0.03059246757235225, 0.03687297607402506] that excludes zero, r2 0.9794473704361031.
The A2 clause would REJECT this candidate anyway: the measured margin over the best trivial baseline is 0.0313, below the 0.05 frozen in preregistration 0002 before any of this data existed.
instrument_validation.why: Until this round every part of the Phase 2 apparatus had only ever run on synthetic fixtures. An instrument that has only measured its own test data has not been shown to work.

method: Run first-hand in session. No subagents and no workflow fan-out - deliberately, because rounds 1-3 put their load-bearing measurements in the weakest verification class by making them in scratch directories that no longer exist. Depth over breadth: fewer candidates, measured.
structural_finding: All five instances of the class named by the round-3 verdict are occupied. A general search confirms why: pseudo-labelling a large unlabelled sensor archive from weak or independent supervision is a named, surveyed methodology across sensing disciplines. Membership in that class is therefore NOT evidence of white space. The round-3 claim that the class was 'a usable specification' is withdrawn in CORRECTIONS.md.
